attempted_claim: Let X,X' be smooth complex Gushel–Mukai threefolds (smooth prime Fano threefolds of index 1, degree 10, Picard rank 1) with Kuznetsov components Ku(X), Ku(X') from Db(X)=<Ku(X),E,O_X>. If there exists a Fourier–Mukai type exact equivalence Phi: Ku(X) -> Ku(X') with no generality assumption on X,X' (ordinary or special), are X and X' birationally equivalent?
decisive_failure: The gap analysis rests on the published hypotheses of JLZ Theorems 6.7, 6.8, 9.3, 9.7, and 10.3 as extracted from the archived text; it does not rule out a future proof via genuinely new reconstruction, invariant, or period-fiber methods. One consolidated literature triage was used and no exhaustive search for unpublished preprints was performed.
